parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Join docs to activities to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Filter for target CHEMBL1980 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows and do not deduplicate. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
